messages:
maria: Heads up — since ~08:10 we've been seeing NCCL hangs on 8xA100 jobs in eu-west-1-gpu. ~20% of runs hit a `Unrecoverable error` in ncclAllReduce and stay stuck until the job is killed.
aj: Which nodes/pool? any recent infra changes?
maria: eu-west-1-gpu pool, nodes with mlx5 bump from last week (kernel+driver). No config changes otherwise. Job scatter: 3 different racks.
devin: Do we have netdev/IB counters for the time window? drops/qp retries?
maria: Pasting snips from the most recent failing run. short output:
```
# ethtool -S ens192 | egrep 'tx_err|rx_err|tx_dropped|rx_dropped'
tx_dropped: 132
rx_dropped: 8
tx_err: 56
# ibv_devinfo -v mlx5_0 | egrep 'port|link_layer|gid' -A2
port: 1
link_layer: Ethernet
GID table length: 128
# dmesg | tail -n40
mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: mlx5e: tx_err: CQE status 0x10 (Hw err)
```
aj: Hmm tx_err/CQE hw err often points to offloads or MTU path issues. Any switch flaps?
liam: I pulled switch logs for the racks — no L2 flaps, but saw a few BDROPS on the ToR for jumbo frames that coincided with the time. Could be MTU mismatch on some hosts.
devin: Can you run `ip -s link show` on one of the affected nodes and `ibstat`/`ibv_rc_pingpong` to repro?
maria: Ran pingpong between GPUs on same host ok. Across hosts fail intermittently. ip -s link output excerpt:
```
2: ens192: mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    RX: bytes 12345678 packets 98765 errors 0 dropped 0
    TX: bytes 87654321 packets 123456 errors 3 dropped 132
```
aj: Dropped TX suggests host NIC queued frames getting dropped upstream. Could be offload mismatch (TSO/GSO) with RoCE on our mlx5 driver. What driver version?
maria: Driver: 5.18.0-rc1 + mlx5_core 5.10.47 (from node image last week).
liam: We saw similar after the 5.18 kernel roll in staging — vendor recommended mlx5 fix that toggles GID type handling and disables a HW offload on certain board revisions.
ops-bot: alert: 8 jobs failed in pool eu-west-1-gpu between 08:07-08:22 — auto-drain suggested for nodes with tx_dropped > 100 in last 15m.
maria: I'm going to drain 3 nodes with tx_dropped >100 to reduce customer impact. Scheduling rolling reboot with older driver rollback for those nodes.
aj: Before rollback, can we force software path as quick test? e.g., disable tso/gso on ens192 and see if nccl stabilizes?
maria: Trying quick test on node-22: `sudo ethtool -K ens192 tso off gso off gro off`. Will run a short NCCL smoke.
(dev 2m later)
maria: Quick smoke for 4-GPU job on node-22 across rack boundary — previously failed, now completed OK. tx_dropped stayed ~0 during run.
devin: That points to an offload interaction. Good repro. Plan: rollback driver + schedule vendor firmware driver patch.
liam: Also add an automated check in node health that flags tx_dropped > 50 in 10m for GPU nodes and auto-evict to avoid silent degradation.
aj: Agreed. For long term: vendor mlx5 firmware + kernel compatibility test matrix. Also validate switch config for RoCE v2 GID types — some ToR configs were sticky after force-upgrade.
maria: Action items: 1) Drain+rollback 6 nodes in eu-west pool (in progress) 2) Temp mitigation: disable tso/gso/gro on GPU nodes via systemd unit (safe?) 3) Vendor patch + firmware schedule with next maintenance window 4) Add tx_dropped alert to autosys
ops-bot: ticket created: INFRA-3314 — "eu-west mlx5 offload tx_dropped causing NCCL hangs" assigned to @aj, @maria. Priority: P1.
aj: Thanks — keep updates here. If rollback fixes all, we'll do a staged roll to the rest of the pool tonight under off-peak. :thumbsup:
